$comment: The MCP authoring contract shared by the Java, .NET and Python backends and the sidecar. See README.md. tools/resources are normative byte for byte; validate.expected is generated from the Java reference (-Dmcp.corpus.write=true) and then frozen.

tools.name: mateu_list_routes
tools.description: List the navigable routes of the Mateu app (derived from its menu). Returns [{route, caption}].

tools.name: mateu_describe_screen
tools.description: Load a screen by route and return a flat description an agent can act on: title, fields (id, label, dataType, required, value, options), actions (id, label), listing (if any), and the current state. Use route "" for the home screen.

route.description: route relative to the mount, "" = home

tools.name: mateu_run_action
tools.description: Run an action on a screen (an action id from mateu_describe_screen), optionally seeding field values via componentState. Returns the resulting screen projection (messages, navigation, new state).

componentState.description: field id -> value; seeds/overrides form state

tools.name: mateu_search
tools.description: Search a listing screen with free text (and optional filter values). Returns the listing.

tools.name: mateu_list_components
tools.description: List the component types a YAML definition can use, each with a one-line description and the names of its main attributes. Read mateu://guide first if you have not authored Mateu YAML before.

query.description: optional: only the types whose name or description contains it

tools.name: mateu_get_component_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema of one component type: every key it accepts with its value type, plus every definition it references (enums, nested records). A #/$defs/Component reference means any component.

type.description: a component type (e.g. FormField) or any other schema definition

tools.name: mateu_validate_uidl
tools.description: Validate a YAML definition (a page, an app shell or any specs/ui file kind) without rendering it. Returns {valid, kind, errors, warnings}; each issue has a code, a message, a JSONPath and its line/column. Errors make the definition fail to load; warnings are ignored keys, undeclared actions and references that do not resolve.

tools.name: mateu_preview_uidl
tools.description: Render a YAML page as the app would — layout only: no view model is bound and nothing is saved — and return {rendered, screen, validation}: the screen projection (title, fields, actions…) plus the validation report.

route.description: optional: the route to render it under (its access rules apply)

devTools.name: mateu_save_spec
devTools.description: Development mode only: validate a YAML definition and, when it has no errors, write it into the app's specs directory (path relative to it, e.g. customers.yaml or partials/address.yaml); live reload shows it in the open browsers. Paths outside the specs directory are refused.

path.description: relative to the specs directory, e.g. customers.yaml

resources.name: Authoring guide
resources.description: How to write Mateu YAML definitions with these tools: the workflow, a sample page and the rules that keep a definition valid.

resources.name: Component catalogue
resources.description: Every component type with a one-line description and its main attributes (generated from the schema).

resources.name: specs/ui schema
resources.description: JSON Schema of every file under specs/ui: pages, app shells, mounts, routes, sources, actions, translations, environments, field types and the project descriptor.

resources.name: Component schema
resources.description: JSON Schema of the component catalogue (UIDL).

validate.name: a-valid-page-without-view-model
validate.why: The guide's sample page: valid; its Save button names an action nothing declares (no view model, no actions:), so one undeclared_action warning.
validate.yaml:
type: VerticalLayout
spacing: true
content:
  - type: Text
    text: Customer
    container: h2
  - type: FormLayout
    content:
      - type: FormField
        id: name
        label: Name
        dataType: string
        required: true
      - type: FormField
        id: email
        label: Email
        dataType: string
        stereotype: email
  - type: HorizontalLayout
    content:
      - type: Button
        label: Save
        actionId: save
        buttonStyle: primary

warnings.message: Action "save" is not declared in this page's actions: (or the action catalogue); it only runs if the view model bound to the page has an action of that name.

validate.name: a-page-bound-to-a-view-model
validate.why: The same page naming its view model: the view model owns the actions, no warning.
validate.yaml:
viewModel: com.acme.CustomerView
type: VerticalLayout
spacing: true
content:
  - type: Text
    text: Customer
    container: h2
  - type: FormLayout
    content:
      - type: FormField
        id: name
        label: Name
        dataType: string
        required: true
      - type: FormField
        id: email
        label: Email
        dataType: string
        stereotype: email
  - type: HorizontalLayout
    content:
      - type: Button
        label: Save
        actionId: save
        buttonStyle: primary

validate.name: decimal-is-not-a-data-type
validate.why: The CLAUDE.md gotcha: dataType: decimal does not exist; the error lists the allowed values.
validate.yaml:
type: FormLayout
content:
  - type: FormField
    id: price
    label: Price
    dataType: decimal

errors.message: "decimal" is not a valid dataType — use one of: integer, string, number, date, time, dateTime, bool, array, file, status, money, component, menu, range, action, actionGroup, dateRange.

validate.name: an-unknown-component-type
validate.why: A misspelt type is suggested by edit distance; a wrong-case one by case-insensitive match.
validate.yaml:
type: VerticalLayout
content:
  - type: Buton
    label: Go
  - type: textField

errors.message: Unknown Component type "Buton". Did you mean "Button"?

validate.name: unknown-keys-are-warnings
validate.why: The loader ignores unknown keys, so they are warnings: a near miss suggests the key, anything else lists the known ones; a non-identifier key is bracketed in the path.
validate.yaml:
type: FormField
id: name
labl: Name
fooBar: 1
my-key: x

warnings.message: Unknown key "fooBar" (ignored). Known keys here: type, id, label, dataType, stereotype, readOnly, required, autofocus, placeholder, description, options, remoteCoordinates, optionsSource, initialValue, style, cssClasses, columns, inlineEditing, onItemSelectionActionId, rowSelectionShortcut, colspan, formPosition, formStyle, formTheme, formColumns, sliderMin, sliderMax, stepButtonsVisible, step, min, max, itemIdPath, attributes, detailPath, useButtonForDetail, minHeightWhenDetailVisible, optionsColumns, mainFilter, treeLeavesOnly, multiline, propertyRow, link, note, eyesOnly, readOnlyUnless, disabledUnless, fieldType, viewModel, modelView, actions, triggers, pageType.

Unknown key "my-key" (ignored). Known keys here: type, id, label, dataType, stereotype, readOnly, required, autofocus, placeholder, description, options, remoteCoordinates, optionsSource, initialValue, style, cssClasses, columns, inlineEditing, onItemSelectionActionId, rowSelectionShortcut, colspan, formPosition, formStyle, formTheme, formColumns, sliderMin, sliderMax, stepButtonsVisible, step, min, max, itemIdPath, attributes, detailPath, useButtonForDetail, minHeightWhenDetailVisible, optionsColumns, mainFilter, treeLeavesOnly, multiline, propertyRow, link, note, eyesOnly, readOnlyUnless, disabledUnless, fieldType, viewModel, modelView, actions, triggers, pageType.

validate.name: a-component-without-type
validate.why: A content entry with no type: is an error; a null entry is accepted (null fits anything).

errors.message: Missing "type": a Component must say which one it is.

validate.name: values-of-the-wrong-type
validate.why: Scalar typing by raw text: quoted \"true\" is still a boolean and \"1.5\" a number (the loader coerces), but maybe/two are not; a number is a valid string; a scalar is not a list.
validate.yaml:
type: FormField
id: n
required: maybe
colspan: two
readOnly: "true"
min: "1.5"
label: 12
options: not-a-list

validate.name: references-that-do-not-resolve
validate.why: Against a context: an unknown source, partial, business component and field type are warnings; create is declared in actions:, globalRefresh is in the action catalogue, export is neither.
validate.yaml:
type: VerticalLayout
actions:
  - id: create
    restAction:
      source:
        ref: planets
content:
  - type: Listing
    rowsSource:
      ref: countries
  - type: Partial
    ref: billing
  - type: Partial
    ref: address
  - type: ComponentRef
    ref: OrderCard
  - type: FormLayout
    content:
      - type: FormField
        id: account
        fieldType: swift
  - type: Button
    label: Create
    actionId: create
  - type: Button
    label: Refresh
    actionId: globalRefresh
  - type: Button
    label: Export
    actionId: export

warnings.message: Source "planets" is not in the source catalogue (sources.yaml).
Component "OrderCard" is not in the business component catalogue (components.yaml).
Field type "swift" is not in the field type catalogue (types.yaml).
Action "export" is not declared in this page's actions: (or the action catalogue); it only runs if the view model bound to the page has an action of that name.

validate.name: a-layout-envelope
validate.why: A page as a layout: envelope with page-level keys.
validate.yaml:
viewModel: com.acme.Orders
pageType: collection
layout:
  type: VerticalLayout
  content:
    - type: Text
      text: Orders

validate.name: an-invalid-page-type
validate.why: Page-level keys beside a root component are validated too: pageType is an enum.
validate.yaml:
type: VerticalLayout
pageType: list
triggers:
  - type: OnLoadTrigger
    actionId: load
content: []

errors.message: "list" is not a valid pageType — use one of: landing, collection, detail, form, process, dashboard.

warnings.message: Action "load" is not declared in this page's actions: (or the action catalogue); it only runs if the view model bound to the page has an action of that name.

validate.name: a-routes-file
validate.why: A route file: an unknown key of a route entry is a warning.
validate.yaml:
type: Routes
routes:
  - route: customers
    layout: customers.yaml
    viewModell: com.acme.Customers
  - route: orders
    layout: orders.yaml

validate.name: a-sources-catalogue
validate.yaml:
type: Sources
sources:
  - name: countries
    source:
      url: https://restcountries.com/v3.1/all
      itemsPath: $

validate.name: a-bare-route-list
validate.why: A route file may be a bare list.

validate.name: not-a-definition
validate.why: A mapping with no type: and no known top-level key is not any kind of definition.

errors.message: Cannot tell what kind of definition this is: give it a `type:` (a component such as VerticalLayout, or a file kind such as UI, Routes or Sources), or a `layout:`, `content:` or `components:` key.

validate.name: a-yaml-syntax-error
validate.why: A syntax error: only the code is normative (the message and position are the YAML parser's).

components.description: A chart (bar, line, pie and others) drawn from labelled datasets.
A Gantt/timeline chart: one row per GanttTask, bars spanning the task's dates on a shared time axis, with per-task progress and a today marker.
A read-only top-down hierarchy chart (org chart, category tree): a single root OrgNode whose children fan out below it, connected by lines.

A planning board / tape chart: one row per PlanningResource, one column per day between from and to, and colored PlanningBlocks spanning their date ranges on their resource's row — the rooms × days grid every hotel/rental/staffing back-office needs.
A read-only lightweight line/area chart: a single series of values plotted as an SVG line (optionally area-filled), with optional x-axis labels, min/max markers and a hover tooltip.

schema.description: A small colored label (chip) for a status or count, optionally with icons.

note.description: A design note: what this piece of the screen is meant to do. For the people and agents reading the file (the visual editor puts notes in the prompts it writes); never rendered.

eyesOnly.description: Who may SEE this component: removed for a caller whose token does not satisfy it (roles/groups/scopes/permissions — AND across, OR within). Decided on the server.

readOnlyUnless.description: Read-only (with every field under it) unless the caller satisfies it; the server also ignores the client's value for a locked field.

disabledUnless.description: Disabled unless the caller satisfies it (a FormField, which has no disabled state, becomes read-only).
